# WorkSpec documentation

> WorkSpec models world state, planned work, resolved execution, domain Constraints, and state rendering.

The canonical language version is WorkSpec 2.2. Package versions and language versions are separate. Changes, Constraints, and Generators execute JavaScript and require trusted-source handling.

## Start here

- [What is WorkSpec?](start/what-is-workspec.md): Product surfaces and the problem that WorkSpec solves.
- [Install and verify](start/install.md): Node.js requirements, package installation, and verification.
- [Your first WorkSpec project](start/first-project.md): A complete project with validation, inspection, a Constraint, and SVG rendering.
- [Learn WorkSpec](learn/world-state.md): The first page in the linear WorkSpec 2.2 curriculum.

## Reference

- [WorkSpec language overview](workspec/overview.md): Canonical authored and resolved layers.
- [Terminology and glossary](workspec/terminology.md): Approved meanings and capitalization for WorkSpec terms.
- [Starting State overview](workspec/starting-state/overview.md): Declarative project structure and reference links.
- [Starting State field index](workspec/starting-state/field-index.generated.md): Canonical fields and their owning pages.
- [Executable source files](workspec/sources/authoring.md): Shared conventions for Changes, Constraints, and Generators.
- [Trusted code and execution security](workspec/sources/security.md): System-wide execution and isolation contract.
- [Execution model](workspec/runtime/execution-model.md): Event order and the authoritative run contract.
- [CLI overview](cli/overview.md): Command workflow and project inputs.
- [CLI reference](cli/reference.md): Commands, options, outputs, and owning pages.
- [JavaScript API overview](api/overview.md): Supported embedding surfaces.
- [JavaScript API reference](api/reference.md): Public and experimental symbols by owner.
- [WorkSpec Studio overview](studio/overview.md): Visual editing and inspection workflows.

## Guides and diagnosis

- [Model a real process](guides/model-real-process.md): Turn a real process into WorkSpec concepts.
- [Debug a broken project](guides/debug-project.md): Validate, inspect, constrain, and render in sequence.
- [Troubleshoot validation](troubleshooting/validation.md): Diagnose document, source, and project-validation failures.
- [Troubleshoot unresolved time](troubleshooting/unresolved-time.md): Diagnose horizons and work-budget exhaustion.
